summary: Comprehensive testing of Financial Runway Simulator feature. All 15 backend API tests passed (100%). All frontend tests passed - toggle button, 3 sliders, 6 quick scenarios, comparison card, 12-month projection chart, insight text, close button, and Share Score Card button all working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend runway-simulator endpoint correctly returns current, simulated, impact, projections, and insight fields
Income/expense percentage changes correctly calculate simulated values
12-month projections array has 13 items (month 0-12) with funds, survivalDays, and level
Insight text dynamically updates based on scenario parameters
Frontend RunwaySimulator.js correctly implements debounced API calls (400ms)
Quick Scenarios buttons have correct data-testid attributes for testing
Current vs Projected comparison card shows level badges (CHAMPION, etc.)
Close button resets sliders to 0 and shows toggle button again
seed_data_creation: None - used existing test user data
context_for_next_testing_agent: Runway Simulator fully tested. Key details: (1) GET /api/intelligence/runway-simulator accepts income_change_pct (-100 to +100), expense_change_pct (-50 to +100), extra_savings (0 to 1000000). (2) Returns: current (survivalDays, effectiveFunds, monthlyExpense, monthlyIncome, level), simulated (same + monthlySavings, levelColor), impact (changeDays, changePct, direction), projections (13 items for months 0-12), insight (dynamic text). (3) Frontend: toggle=runway-simulator-toggle, widget=runway-simulator-widget, sliders=income-slider/expense-slider/savings-slider, scenarios=scenario-job-loss/scenario-50--pay-cut/scenario-cut-20--expenses/scenario--2l-savings/scenario-raise---save/scenario-reset, close=simulator-close-btn. (4) Simulator appears below Emergency Runway widget on /insights page.
